high_level_description: The image shows the back of a Dyson Airwrap Complete Long hair styling tool box. The box is predominantly white with black text and features an image of the hair styling tool itself, which is silver with a copper-colored accent near the top. The tool has a cylindrical shape with a handle at the bottom. The text on the box highlights the product's features: "Dyson Airwrap Complete Long" "Dry. Curl. Shape. Smooth and hide flyaways." "With no heat damage." "Made possible with Coanda air styling" "Propelled by the Dyson digital motor V9" Below
